integrity: All finite claims are reconstructed from the explicit coordinate graph by the bundled verifier. Complete Hasse-diagram acyclicity is checked for the discrete-Morse matchings, and the scale-4 Morse boundary is reduced over the integers. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result uses the shortest-path metric on the truncated-octahedral one-skeleton, not the Euclidean or spherical metric. Equivariant homotopy types and filtration maps are not classified. A poorly indexed equivalent finite computation remains a residual originality risk.
title: Complete graph-metric Vietoris--Rips filtration of the truncated octahedral graph
